s1.title: A live digital twin of the network
s1.text: Every bridge, tunnel and dam is a 3D twin built from its members: piers, girders, arches. Each one is coloured by live sensor health.

s2a.title: Real bridge. Real data.
s2a.text: This is railway bridge KW51 near Leuven, replaying fifteen months of real monitoring data. The twin removes temperature and frost effects, and watches what is left.

s2b.text: In 2019 the bridge was strengthened. The twin flags the stiffness change from the data alone, and Muse Spark assesses it like a structural engineer.

s3a.title: An AI inspector
s3a.text: Now a real inspection photo. Muse Spark reads it like a senior engineer, and SAM 3.1 turns every defect into a pixel-accurate mask.

s3b.text: Each defect, its severity, and the member it sits on, plus a written assessment and the recommended action, in about twenty seconds.

s4a.title: Seeing around obstacles
s4a.text: A crack on Pier 4 hides behind a drainage pipe. Flying straight at it, a drone would see only thirty percent of it.

s4b.text: Muse Wonder tests camera angles with the twin's geometry engine, and finds the one that sees all of it, with a collision-checked flight to get there.

s5a.title: Two years from now
s5a.text: What if nobody acts? Muse Spark reasons about the damage mechanism, and Muse Image shows it on the real photo.

s5b.text: Six months: water from the pipe keeps the crack wet, and it widens.

s5c.text: Two years: efflorescence and rust streaks. The reinforcement is corroding.

s5d.text: Or repaired: the crack injected and sealed. It is an illustration, not a prediction, but it makes the risk tangible.

s6a.title: Hands-free in the field
s6a.text: On site, the inspector just speaks.

s6b.text: Muse Voice transcribes it, Muse Spark understands it, and the twin acts: a field note, and a new drone mission.

s7.title: InfraTwin-Live
s7.text: Monitor, inspect, act. From a sensor drifting on a real bridge, to an AI inspection, to a drone flight that sees around obstacles, in minutes instead of a site visit.

command.text: Note a shear crack on Pier 4, and plan a drone re-scan around the drainage pipe.
